disclosure: The missing historical objects, the historical LEFT 1/10 and RIGHT 10/10 result, and the failed V2-A008 current-stack sensitivity probe were known before this amendment. This is a prospective bridge cohort, not hidden preregistration, historical recovery, or exact replication.

checkpoint.norm_stats_rule: Load and hash assets/droid/norm_stats.json from this checkpoint; do not use or download the config's pi05 asset path.

prompts.left: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
prompts.right: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.

19-file checkpoint hash and checkpoint-local norm-stat hash

required_pass: sampling seed attested on every request
exact prompt SHA-256 attested on every request
LEFT and repeated LEFT actions bit-identical
LEFT and RIGHT tokenized prompt hashes differ
LEFT and RIGHT action hashes differ
LEFT versus RIGHT action RMS greater than zero

sequential_release.behavioral_release: All 40 cells release once, and only once, after every model-blind check and the three-request gate pass on the exact bridge identity.
sequential_release.failure_rule: If any gate fails, run zero behavioral cells, preserve the probe, and require another disclosed amendment before changing a revision, config, checkpoint, adapter, prompt, or seed.

reporting_boundary.bridge_denominator: Report LEFT and RIGHT out of 20 for the bridge cohort only.
reporting_boundary.historical_denominator: Report the immutable historical LEFT and RIGHT out of 10 side-by-side only.
prohibited: pooled confidence intervals or paired tests across runtime identities
describing the bridge as recovered historical code
reporting_boundary.estimand: Prospective language steerability of the pi0-FAST checkpoint under the disclosed recoverable public compatibility stack.
